scope_statement: Read-only source/interface/failure-path review of frozen M1.4 production directory, reconciliation, five new tests/fixtures, two new tools; baseline non-runtime source/tests/tools, ADRs and M1.3 evidence reviewed earlier. Source review is not OS deployment acceptance.
set_hash_algorithm: SHA256(sorted(path + NUL + lowercase SHA256 + LF)); paths relative to source root, slash-separated UTF-8

baseline.runtime_scope_limit: M1.3 runtime implementations were not assigned for this reviewer full reread; hashes were independently checked and contracts were consulted. M1.4 production Windows implementations were fully read.

findings.title: Audit logical role polluted exact AuditInput fields
Mutable CREATE content and invalid-input slot accounting
findings.resolution: Validate bounded Uint8Array inside try, copy before awaiting, and compare actual result hash to signed content hash.

findings.title: File grant wall rollback and original Permit monotonic expiry
findings.resolution: Latched rollback rejection, wall/monotonic fence, and original consumed Permit lease check.

findings.title: Unsettled file/identity observations and pending admission limits
findings.resolution: Bounded deadlines/abort, retained unsettled quotas and admission limits.

findings.title: Disconnected cyclic exit parent graph accepted as complete
findings.resolution: Each member parent chain must reach the unique pinned root and reject cycles.

findings.title: Asynchronous file commit and expired Envelope start fences
findings.resolution: Recheck within the native work microtask; validate deadline before/after observations and synchronously before start.

findings.title: Unverified exit retired supervision and returned production PASS
findings.resolution: Incomplete evidence terminates/quarantines and retains active work; REAL returns INCONCLUSIVE, nonzero exit FAIL.

findings.title: Stale boot/resource-version release authorization
findings.resolution: Current boot, allowed Host state, five HELD resource versions and single consumption rechecked inside reconciliation transaction.

findings.title: Registry close left existing authorizations readable as ACTIVE
findings.resolution: Closed inspect refuses immediately, fencing Gateway and endpoint callers.

findings.title: Remote recovery inferred local NOT_INVOKED and missed inflight operations
findings.resolution: Remote recovery retains UNKNOWN; persistent inflight flag blocks adjudication until retired/recovered.

findings.title: Remote Artifact import was outside the Host deadline
findings.resolution: Send and accept share timeout/cancellation; Artifact puts receive AbortSignal, raw hash/bytes verified before proof insertion.

findings.title: Service disconnect lacked operation ownership
findings.resolution: Broker owns channel-to-operation mapping and terminates/quarantines without accepting caller-supplied operation ownership.

findings.title: Consumed failures lost operation ID and claimed NOT_RESERVED
findings.resolution: Committed flag survives cleanup failures; Host preserves association and returns INCONCLUSIVE/UNKNOWN for consumed or storage-uncertain paths.

findings.title: Signed Broker proof envelope was not retained for offline verification
findings.resolution: Immutable signed_packet remains separate from original proof body and Host imports; audit binds packet hash and owner release re-verifies with pinned Broker public key.

evidence_scope.early_failed_probe: First inline model attempt stopped on INVALID_RECORD_FIELDS; failure stack preserved in tool transcript. No Windows boundary was exercised.
evidence_scope.post_fix_method: Source recheck only after instruction to stop probes; regression assertions read but not executed by reviewer.
evidence_scope.author_native_jsonl_claim: Final run native JSONL completely parsed; preserved raw_jsonl checked against frame and frame bound. Primitive orphan window and conservative membership/release fields rechecked. No tests independently executed.

limitations: Default qualification certificates are empty. No production dispatch is admitted by default.

WindowsSupervisor uses fixed trusted tool mapping and pinned suspended prepare/bind/grant/resume interface. Native observations retain membership_complete=false and unknown_members=true; network/filesystem/limits are not certified by the adapter, so no production release proof is emitted.
Restricted-token source access masks are 0x8A for token.restrict and 0x8B for launch; only the restricted clone is adjusted. Their source was rechecked, not independently run.
Real OS subprocess fixture has SIMULATED peer, identity, Job, qualification and release security. A real subprocess does not prove real OS security.

Separate approved accounts, profiles, ACLs, protected IPC, complete process membership, hard file/disk limits, final platform qualification, OS reboot/hard-power-loss and Ubuntu remain separate blocked/not-run acceptance work.
Native helper termination or Promise completion is not proof of full OS tree exit; unknown claims/outputs remain retained.
Node syntax checks and this source review do not establish static tsc correctness.

The exact final run is bound below by source/path/bytes/hash and raw log structure. This is independent evidence recheck, not independently rerunning the suite; earlier mismatched runs retain historical status only.
write_scope: Only final-review.md and final-review.json written in this final phase. Earlier targeted probe script/results and synthetic SQLite/artifact data were created solely in independent-review runtime. No product source, test, configuration, system account, ACL, firewall, profile or server changed by reviewer.
